## Expression on this line

The System line at orange Stage 11 is **meta-systemic governance**: governance as systems-of-
systems, with the parts' relations and aggregate effects visible to the parts and to the
public. This is the cellar-ladder moment when the parts-not-whole complex of amber Stage 9 has
made two constitutive changes. First, distinct subsystems are not fiefs of authority but
*mutually constraining semi-autonomous institutes* — central-bank independence, audit-and-
accounts independence, judiciary independence, agency independence, ombudsman-and-public-
protector offices, independent statistical offices, regulatory commissions. Second, the system
*talks to itself* as a system: recurring published second-order reports, system-scope governance
documents, parliamentary-committee reviews of computed aggregates from parts-of-the-state,
strategic-decision-traceability meeting published-procedure standards.

The constitutive elements are:

- **Institutional separation.** Distinct subsystems hold published separation-of-powers
  relations and act under published-procedure constraints.
- **Published system-level feedback.** The functioning system-of-systems produces periodic
  published documents (annual reports, white papers, statistical compendia) that present its
  own parts' outputs in a system frame, where these documents are *contestable* in published
  form by opposition parties, the academy, and citizens.
- **Recurring review of recurring-aggregate functions.** The system has built-in feedback for
  itself: review-the-reviewer bodies, ombudsmen-of-ombudsmen, statutory review-every-N-year cycles,
  and capacity to *reframe* what the system's parts are aiming at (changing an office's acted-on
  target-by-statute).
- **Cross-jurisdiction statistical-discipline regimes.** The system voluntarily submits to
  cross-jurisdiction statistical-discipline regimes that constrain how it reports.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion — what a higher CoG must keep from orange-11)

- **UL:** the practitioner's analytic-discipline — the trained capacity to ask about *the second-
  order consequence* of one's decision and the system-context within which one's decision acts;
  the internalized meta-systemic-vigilance.
- **UR:** semi-autonomous institutes operating under constitutional separation-of-powers;
  distributed-power institutions, agencies, and commissions.
- **LL:** a polity that *holds the system accountable* and contests parts' outputs in published
  form — opposition parties, academic-policy surveillance, active civil society, free press.
- **LR:** published system-level reports; separate-and-independent institute architecture; the
  statutory scaffolding that produces parts' outputs and parts' targets and parts' recursion.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction (clinging to orange-11):** **bureaucratic-fetishism** — published reports kept
  as evidence of system-operation when their contents reveal co-dependence with executive-
  preference decisions; precedent-hallucination compliance that hides agency-capture with
  elaborate publication.
- **Dark allergy (orange-11 foundation skipped/fragile):** institutional separation-on-paper only
  — the published-procedure system frame on the spreadsheet, the underlying decisions co-travelling
  with executive-preference; the *onelightness* of recentralization and capture not visible in
  published-output statistics.
- **Golden addiction (grasping Green prematurely):** **stakeholder-as-network obscuring agency** —
  conflation of multi-stakeholder process with second-order contestation, *the public-aggregating
  everything is the system-now* rather than *the people running the system remain the system-now*;
  network-icons over substance.
- **Golden allergy (Jonah / refusing orange-11):** nationalist-refusalism — refuses any
  international statistical-discipline regime, refuses independent institute architecture as
  outside-party-plot, refuses opposition-or-academic contestation as anti-national; the
  parts-not-whole complex of amber-9 preferred over the orange-redistribution of agency and
  the green re-integration.

## Diagnostic cues (universal signal-types)

Falsifiable signal *types* that place a system-of-institutions holon at **orange Stage 11**. State
the signal as a class; the specific real-world instance lives in the Entity holon that cites this
cell.

- **Cross-jurisdiction statistical-discipline regime signatory and submitting.** Voluntary
  participation in cross-jurisdiction statistical-discipline regimes that constrain how
  the system reports.
- **Parliamentary-committee published reviews.** A track-record of parliamentary-committee
  published reviews of system-aggregate outputs, with minority views, and with cabinet-minister or
  agency-head attendance at recurring cadence.
- **Independent statistical agency-functional.** Presence of an independent statistical agency
  with published autonomy statutes, periodic published-data-quality assessments, and
  authoritative-aggregate publication on which ministry-bureaus depend.
- **Absence of recentralization-pattern.** Audit-trail data showing that the publication of
  system-aggregates is *not* correlated with executive-curtain operation during recapture
  episodes — i.e. **anti-recentralization* design survives the election-cycle.
- **Cross-published parts outputs.** Different parts of the system regularly publish their
  internal aggregates and these are cross-comparable along consistent published methodologies
  (the system has internally visible consistent-methodology rather than opacity-as-parts-policy).
- **Selective-statistic-publication exceptions routinized.** No routine selective-
  statistic-publication exception — disparities in statistic-by-part publication are visible,
  demanded, and value-base-defended as publishable-not-merely-clerical.
- **Cross-aggregate-published cross-cited.** System-aggregate publications cite academic-literature
  on the problem-system on which they report; their findings are cited from the academic and
  press side as a published second-order-report.

## Sources, joints, open questions

- **Sources:** Wilber, *Integral Psychology* (altitude/orange); Beck & Cowan, *Spiral Dynamics*
  (worldcentric emergence); Commons/MHC transition Order 9 (Concrete) to Order 10 (Abstract);
  Kegan, *In Over Our Heads* (order 3→4); Luhmann, *Social Systems* (operative closure, formally
  described at the level of pure form); Senge, *The Fifth Discipline* (systems-thinking s
  reference); Meadows, *Thinking in Systems*; OECD, *Government at a Glance*; OECD statistical-
  discipline-report series; World Bank's World Development Indicators as the cross-country
  statistics-regime example; Sarkozy-commission *In the Wake of the Crisis* (independent-
  statistical-agency literature); Burns & World Bank Independent-Evaluation-Group lineages.

- **Open joints:** What semi-autonomous institutions are load-bearing for orange meta-systemic
  governance, and which can be quietly captured under cover of the orange form without exposing
  the system to the next-step pathology? Is there an orange-stable *system-of-systems* without
  the presence of internally-active multi-stakeholder surveillance-of-the-system?

  meta-systemic foundations); cross-link the `governance` line at Stage 11
